brief.headline: Ask for a 10–15% price cut: they keep 7.4% profit versus 5.0% for similar firms, so there's room in their price

priceAsk.summary: Push for a 10–15% price reduction on rigid plastic packaging, targeting the lower end of the market band
priceAsk.target: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for induction-wad caps (market ask shows ₹0.55–1.20/pc band, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc)
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume. They keep 7.4% profit versus 5.0% peer median — that gap gives room to cut price while staying profitable

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days earlier (15 days after receipt instead of 30) in exchange for half the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier costs us ₹1.64 L in cash; they borrow money at about 7.02%, so early payment is worth roughly that rate to them — trade it for a matching price reduction

brief.financialLeverage: PGP Glass is very healthy — CARE A+ / Stable rating, ₹3373.51 Cr revenue, and they keep 7.4% profit (better than the 5.0% peer median). Their cash is stuck for 78 days, a bit longer than similar firms at 71 days, so cash is somewhat tight. But we're tiny — just ₹39.99 L spend, 0.01% of their sales — so we have almost no pull on our own. Two watch-outs: EPF payment delays and pending legal cases. The play is to line up a credible second source (Manjushree Technopack or Mold-Tek) and use that to get the price cut, not to squeeze a fragile supplier (they're not fragile).

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100); top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma) — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: Manufacturer lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — India-Pan presence, medium confidence

risks: We're only 0.01% of their sales — no leverage unless we bundle more volume or threaten to switch to Manjushree or Mold-Tek
EPF payment delays and pending legal cases flagged — watch for any supply disruption if those escalate
Their financial health zone is grey (Altman Z 1.45) — not distress, but not rock-solid either; push on price but keep a second source ready
Market ask shows only 'modest headroom' to the lower band — don't expect a huge cut without committing volume or longer term
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about bringing your price down 10–15% to match the market band we're seeing — you're keeping 7.4% profit versus 5% for similar firms, so there's room, and we're ready to commit volume and pay you faster in return.
